name: Long March 2D (configuration 2, two-stage)

cd.note: transferred from LM-3B fit (same 3.35 m YF-21/YF-24 hypergolic core family; LM-2D S1 common with LM-4 series per huijiwiki), see fixed_params

glow_kg.note: 起飞质量 251 t (Shanghai Hangtian 2025 review via huijiwiki); check only. Wikipedia infobox lists 232.25 t (older config)

propellant_kg.note: S1 propellant 182 t (World Launch Vehicles 2nd ed. 2007 via huijiwiki; Wikipedia agrees 182,000 kg)

dry_kg.derived: huijiwiki S1 mass 193 t - propellant 182 t

thrust_sl_N.note: S1 SL thrust 2961.6 kN (YF-21B per 2007 data; current YF-21C 2992.8 kN not used, kept consistent with the 2007 data set; Wikipedia 2961.6 kN)

thrust_vac_N.derived: SL 2961.6 kN x YF-20 vac/SL thrust ratio 816.3/731.5 (https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/YF-20), same method as lm4b.json

isp_vac_s.derived: SL Isp 2550 m/s / g0 = 260.03 s (huijiwiki) x same ratio, so mdot unchanged from the published SL pair

cutoff_s.note: typical sequence: 一级发动机关机 153.9 s (computer cutoff command 151.2 s)

separation_s.note: typical sequence: 一二级分离 155.1 s

isp_vac_s.derived: 2942 m/s / g0 (huijiwiki lists 300.2 s; m/s figure used)

ignition_s.assumption: ignition at S1/S2 separation (only separation published); gives main burn 169.0 s = published S2 main working time 169 s

cutoff_s.note: typical sequence: 二级主机关机 324.1 s

separation_s.note: typical sequence: 星箭分离 737.1 s (payload separation)

cutoff_s.note: typical sequence: 二级游机关机 705.1 s

tail.runs_with_main_basis: ASSUMPTION (same as lm2c/lm4b): verniers run from S2 ignition to the published vernier cutoff (550 s, 9.15 t burned; total S2 burn 51.8 t vs 53 t load). CONFLICT: huijiwiki vernier working time 382 s ~= 705.1-324.1 s would imply vernier-only operation, but that leaves ~4.1 t of the 53 t load unburned and the fit cannot reach orbit at the typical vernier cutoff, so it is not used

mass_kg.note: 3.35 m fairing structure mass 860 kg; fairing TYPE for this flight unknown (2.9/3.35/3.8/4.0/4.2 m exist) so 3.35 m is an ASSUMPTION

jettison_time_s.note: typical sequence: 整流罩分离 185.1 s

vertical_rise_s.note: typical sequence: 程序转弯 17.0 s

cd.derived: FITTED LM-3B value transferred; filled at run time from vehicles/lm3b.json fitted_family

payload_kg.basis: upper bound LM-2D LEO capability 4 t (huijiwiki); payload unknown

header_notes: LM-2D TIMELINE mode: configuration-2 stage data (World Launch Vehicles 2nd ed. 2007 via huijiwiki) + SAST TYPICAL flight sequence (huijiwiki); all event times hard constraints. Typical sequence, not this flight's.
